typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CUSTOMER as string,
		ENTITY as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		ORDER_ID as string,
		CHANGE_REASON as string,
		PARENT_PRODUCT_ID as string,
		ORDER_CREATED_TIME as string,
		ORDER_UPDATED_TIME as string,
		LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPE as string,
		TRADKING_DESK as string,
		TRADE_DATE as string,
		MODIFY_AMEND as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FileName = toString(($sFileName))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileName} = FileName) ~> DataConversion
DerivedColumn aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion sink(input(
		TRADKING_DESK as string,
		FileName as string,
		PARENT_PRODUCT_ID as string,
		ORDER_UPDATED_TIME as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		MODIFY_AMEND as string,
		ENTITY as string,
		ORDER_ID as string,
		CHANGE_REASON as string,
		ORDER_CREATED_TIME as string,
		TRADE_DATE as string,
		CUSTOMER as string,
		LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TRADKING_DESK,
		FileName = {Copy of FileName},
		PARENT_PRODUCT_ID,
		ORDER_UPDATED_TIME,
		ACCOUNT,
		MODIFY_AMEND,
		ENTITY,
		ORDER_ID,
		CHANGE_REASON,
		ORDER_CREATED_TIME,
		TRADE_DATE,
		CUSTOMER,
		LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
